proof_body:
by
  intro R _ _ _ a b
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (IsPrincipalIdealRing.principal (Ideal.span {a, b}))
  have hd' : Ideal.span {a, b} = Ideal.span {d} := hd
  have hmem : d ∈ Ideal.span {a, b} := by
    rw [hd']
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self d
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_pair.mp hmem
  refine ⟨d, x, y, by rw [← hxy]; ring, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← hd']
    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  · rw [← Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← hd']
    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  · intro e h1 h2
    rw [← hxy]
    exact dvd_add (h1.mul_left x) (h2.mul_left y)
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] (a b : R), ∃ d x y : R, d = a * x + b * y ∧ d ∣ a ∧ d ∣ b ∧ ∀ e : R, e ∣ a → e ∣ b → e ∣ d
